description:
The future of foldables is finally unfolding. Today we take a first look at the **Samsung Galaxy Z Trifold**, Samsung’s boldest innovation yet—featuring a tri-fold AMOLED display, a powerful flagship chipset, and a design that transforms your phone at 6.5 inches to a into a full 10 -inchtablet in seconds.

This hands-on showcases the Z Trifold’s unique folding mechanism, design details, software experience, and full device specifications so you can get a clear picture of what Samsung’s next-gen foldable brings to the table.
